Circular No.: 15 /2026
All Provincial Secretaries of Education
All Provincial Directors of Education
All Zonal Directors of Education
All Divisional Directors of Education
All the Heads of Venerable Theros of the Pirivena
All the Principals
Vesak Week of the Sri Buddha Years 2570
Actions have been arranged to be celebrated the State Vesak Festival on the 27th of May 2026 at Midellawala, Thihagoda, Matara.
Implement the Vesak Week programme from 26.05.2026 to 02.06.2026 in schools, NCE, pirivenas and teacher training colleges.

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Provincial Secretaries/Directors of Education, Zonal and Divisional Directors, Pirivena and Seelamatha heads, Principals
gold.title: MOE Circular 15/2026: Vesak Week programmes for Sri Buddha Year 2570

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Directs schools and related institutions to implement a Vesak Week programme aligned with the State Vesak Festival (27 May 2026) and Vesak Full Moon Poya (30 May 2026).

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Run the model Vesak Week plan from 26.05.2026 to 02.06.2026 covering health, values, Amisa puja, virtuous meditation, cultural programmes, spiritual development, and environment/Clean Sri Lanka activities. Avoid disrespectful or disharmony-promoting events.

sections.heading: Responsible parties
sections.content: Provincial/Zonal/Divisional education offices, principals, Pirivena and NCE heads must implement and inform institutions under them.

actionItems: Schedule Vesak Week activities from 26.05.2026 to 02.06.2026 using the model programme.
Brief staff and students on respectful, harmony-preserving observances.
Inform pirivenas, national schools, and teacher education institutions as directed.
Keep economical energy use in mind for Vesak decorations and events.
